{{Top}}
A '''soufflé''' was a type of food. The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]] was revered for the soufflés she baked, which were known as "Malla's secret soufflés." She made some for the 200th [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]] party of her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].
